About UXTeam

UXTeam is a UX research and strategy driven product design partner helping digital product studios and agencies improve execution quality, delivery consistency, and conversion focused user experience outcomes.

We operate as a white label UX partner, integrating directly into existing workflows to support UX strategy, research, and design execution across complex digital projects.

About Squaircle

Squaircle is a AI Transformation Studio led by Saravanan Vijayakumar, operating across USA and India, working with clients in healthcare, fintech, and manufacturing to deliver end to end digital product solutions.

  • Healthcare
  • Fintech
  • Manufacturing

The Challenges

Scaling without losing quality or predictability

Inconsistent UX quality standards

Delivery varied project to project with no consistent baseline

Internal team bandwidth pressure

Growing project load with limited internal capacity to absorb it

No predictable delivery process

Timelines were hard to protect across multiple concurrent projects

As Squaircle scaled its project load across industries, maintaining consistent UX quality, delivery speed, and internal bandwidth became increasingly challenging.

The team needed a partner who could integrate seamlessly into their workflow, reduce execution pressure, and maintain strong UX standards across multiple concurrent client projects.

The challenge was not just about design capacity, but about creating a more predictable and reliable delivery system.

What UXTeam did

UXTeam’s approach across three delivery areas

Embedded UX Strategy Support

Integrated into Squircle’s delivery workflow to support UX strategy, research, and execution across multiple client projects.

Cross Industry UX Execution Support

Worked across healthcare, fintech, and manufacturing projects, ensuring consistent UX quality and structured delivery standards across domains.

Workflow Integration and Delivery Stabilization

Helped streamline UX execution processes, reduce dependency friction, and improve predictability across ongoing client work.

The Outcome:
More Predictable and Scalable UX Delivery

The partnership resulted in improved operational stability and stronger UX consistency across Squircle’s client projects.

  1. 1Improved delivery predictability across multiple projects
  2. 2Stronger UX quality consistency across industries
  3. 3Reduced internal coordination load
  4. 4Higher confidence in scaling client engagements
  5. 5More stable and reliable UX execution workflow

The collaboration enabled Squircle to scale project delivery with greater ease and reduced operational friction.

Full Client Q&A

Q.

What was breaking or becoming difficult in your design delivery before you started working with UXTeam?

A.

As we scaled across multiple projects, maintaining consistent UX quality and managing delivery timelines became challenging. We needed a partner who could integrate into our workflow and help stabilize execution across different client demands.

Q.

When evaluating partners, what made UXTeam feel like the right fit beyond just design capability?

A.

What stood out was the clarity of thinking, ownership in delivery, and the ability to integrate smoothly into our existing workflows. UXTeam didn’t feel like an external vendor but more like an extension of our internal team.

Q.

Where has UXTeam made the biggest difference in how your team delivers work today?

A.

UXTeam has improved how confidently we deliver work to clients. Their reliability, structured approach, and consistency have helped us maintain higher standards while working under tight timelines and expectations.

Q.

How has working with UXTeam impacted your ability to scale projects or protect or improve your margins?

A.

It has allowed us to scale projects more comfortably without increasing internal hiring pressure. The ability to rely on a consistent UX partner has improved our efficiency and overall delivery flow.

Q.

What’s something UXTeam does consistently that makes your life easier as an agency partner?

A.

The biggest difference is ease of collaboration. We don’t need constant follow-ups. Work moves forward smoothly, and there is a strong sense of ownership and reliability throughout the process.

Q.

If another agency asked you about UXTeam, how would you describe the partnership in one or two lines?

A.

Dependable partners who think with you, not just work for you.
